report.title: ATM Sentinel official PS04CCTV requirements compliance audit
report.source_of_truth: Current implementation and executed narrowly scoped tests; previous reports and status documents were not treated as proof.
statuses_allowed: OUT OF SCOPE — CORRECTLY NOT IMPLEMENTED
OUT OF SCOPE — UNEXPECTED IMPLEMENTATION FOUND

overall_official_compliance.note: Includes key features, good-to-have items, cross-cutting requirements, four correctly absent out-of-scope controls, and R4C validation. Internal engineering assessment only; not official Rajasthan Police certification.

local_technical_verification.note: Measures which official capabilities were actually verified locally by executed tests, not simple test pass rate. 215 backend and 65 frontend selected tests passed.

requirements.official_requirement: Accept MP4, AVI, MOV, MKV, WMV, FLV and MPEG/MPG files and compatible CCTV/DVR/NVR exports.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Cases.tsx:176-190 and Investigation.tsx:150-164 file upload; Cases.tsx:312-315 format caveat copy.
requirements.test_result: Passed: mp4/avi/mov/mkv accepted; invalid/unsafe uploads rejected.
requirements.what_works: Four local containers are validated by extension, magic bytes, ffprobe and full decode.
requirements.partial: WMV, FLV, MPEG/MPG and genuine DVR/NVR exports are not accepted; only conversion guidance is provided.
requirements.missing: Vendor-specific export parsing and the three additional container families.
requirements.limitations: No real DVR/NVR sample was available; extension allowlist alone is not counted as support.
requirements.evidence: test_security.py and test_video.py assertions plus executed test pass result.

requirements.official_requirement: Detect codec, resolution and duration.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Investigation.tsx:224-242 displays metadata; Workspace.tsx:208-218 shows timestamp/alignment metadata.
requirements.test_result: Passed: ffprobe metadata and full decode verified for synthetic containers.
requirements.what_works: ffprobe-derived streams include codec, width, height, fps and duration.
requirements.partial: No proprietary DVR metadata format is interpreted.
requirements.missing: Nothing for local container support.
requirements.limitations: Metadata quality depends on ffprobe and the supplied file.
requirements.evidence: test_probe_synthetic_video and container parametrized probe tests.

requirements.official_requirement: Validate files and normalise them with FFmpeg when required.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Workspace.tsx:91-112 normalization action.
requirements.test_result: Passed: full decode and normalized MP4 derivative verified.
requirements.what_works: Size, magic bytes, full decode, H.264 MP4 derivative creation and SHA-256 for derivatives work locally.
requirements.partial: Normalization is video-only and drops audio.
requirements.missing: Automatic transcode of unsupported containers is absent.
requirements.limitations: Conversion guidance in security.py:45 mentions AAC audio while runtime normalization drops audio; not a functional break for video analysis.
requirements.evidence: test_supported_container_upload_verify_extract_and_normalize for avi/mov/mkv.

requirements.official_requirement: Report unsupported or proprietary formats with clear conversion/export instructions.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Upload error copy and DVR/NVR H.264 MP4 export advice.
requirements.test_result: Passed: unsupported extension and magic mismatch messages asserted.
requirements.what_works: Clear FFmpeg conversion and vendor export guidance is returned.
requirements.partial: No vendor-specific decision tree or automated conversion.
requirements.missing: Proprietary format handling.
requirements.limitations: Guidance is static text.
requirements.evidence: test_unsupported_extension_explains_conversion and test_magic_byte_validation.

requirements.official_requirement: Detect and track people across the clip.
requirements.frontend_workflow: CvRuns.tsx launch and observation cards.
requirements.test_result: Passed: tracker unit tests and stubbed scenario tests; status test asserts experimental_unvalidated.
requirements.what_works: YOLOX detector wiring, pinned model hash gate, deterministic clip-local IoU/centroid tracking and observation recording work.
requirements.partial: Person detector is marked experimental_unvalidated; no real CCTV accuracy test.
requirements.missing: Validated ATM-scene person detection and cross-clip identity continuity.
requirements.limitations: Clip-local track IDs are not identities; zero detections do not prove absence.
requirements.evidence: test_tracker_* tests, test_cv_status_endpoint_reports_models_and_disclaimer.

requirements.official_requirement: Focus on the person at the ATM keypad or cash slot.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Explicit disclaimer only; no keypad/cash-slot workflow.
requirements.test_result: Passed tests assert association limitation copy, not association functionality.
requirements.what_works: The system avoids false identity/operator claims.
requirements.partial: Nothing.
requirements.missing: ATM keypad/cash-slot region detection, person-to-region association and transaction-participant linking.
requirements.limitations: Transaction time only selects video windows.
requirements.evidence: CV_ASSOCIATION_LIMITATION constant and export disclaimer tests.

requirements.official_requirement: Use transaction time from a bank statement or ATM journal with a configurable time window.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Transaction entry and before/after window controls exist.
requirements.test_result: Passed: timestamp parsing, bounds and CV window payloads asserted.
requirements.what_works: Manual ISO-8601 transaction and CCTV timestamps plus bounded window inputs.
requirements.partial: No statement/journal ingestion.
requirements.missing: OCR/import of bank statement or ATM journal timestamps.
requirements.limitations: Investigator enters all times.
requirements.evidence: test_parse_timestamp, test_analyze_window, buildCvRunPayload test.

requirements.official_requirement: Align transaction time to CCTV video time.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Investigation.tsx:92-117 and 272-289 alignment preview; CvRuns.tsx:967-984 provenance.
requirements.test_result: Passed: offsets, clamping, boundaries, source timeline preservation and derivative provenance asserted.
requirements.what_works: Mathematical alignment, window clamping and provenance are local-verified.
requirements.partial: No independent verification of the CCTV clock.
requirements.missing: OCR/automatic CCTV clock extraction.
requirements.limitations: Naive timestamps are treated as UTC and manual offsets are accepted with warnings.
requirements.evidence: test_aligned_run_analyzes_only_window_and_preserves_source_timeline and related alignment tests.

requirements.official_requirement: Score sharpness, pose angle, illumination and occlusion.
requirements.frontend_workflow: CvRuns.tsx:496-533 renders scores and heuristic flags.
requirements.test_result: Passed: score ranges, components, blur/exposure/size warnings and disclaimers asserted.
requirements.what_works: Explainable weighted heuristic scores and warnings are produced.
requirements.partial: Pose is geometric proxy, not calibrated 3D; occlusion is landmark-boundary heuristic.
requirements.missing: Validation against human quality labels or real CCTV conditions.
requirements.limitations: Scores measure crop usability, not identity or correctness.
requirements.evidence: test_face_quality_is_explainable_and_does_not_classify_attributes; quality LIMITATIONS constant.

requirements.official_requirement: Select the best frames.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Observation ranking and select-for-export controls.
requirements.test_result: Passed: caps preserve totals, report truncation and near-duplicate suppression asserted.
requirements.what_works: Quality-priority retention, near-duplicate suppression and response-budget pruning work.
requirements.partial: No explicit 'best identifiable face of the ATM operator' selection.
requirements.missing: Best-frame-per-linked-person selection and human-facing best-frame summary.
requirements.limitations: Selection is similarity/candidate-oriented with explicit human review.
requirements.evidence: test_analysis_observation_cap_retains_best_evidence and near-duplicate tests.

requirements.official_requirement: Flag masks, helmets, caps and partial faces so investigators understand frame reliability.
requirements.frontend_workflow: CvRuns.tsx:515-526 shows signals and not assessed attributes.
requirements.test_result: Passed: partial-occlusion flags and not_assessed attributes asserted.
requirements.what_works: Partial occlusion is a review warning; mask/helmet/cap are honestly marked not_assessed.
requirements.partial: Only one of four reliability attributes has a heuristic signal.
requirements.missing: Validated mask, helmet and cap classifiers and a real partial-face classifier.
requirements.limitations: Flags are uncalibrated and not identity conclusions.
requirements.evidence: flags block in cv/quality.py and executed contract tests.

requirements.official_requirement: Search for the same person in other ATM clips using face embeddings.
requirements.frontend_workflow: CvRuns.tsx:699-824 candidate search panel.
requirements.test_result: Passed: mechanics, provenance, scope and source exclusion asserted.
requirements.what_works: Case-scoped, top-K, source-excluded cosine-similarity candidate search with v4 provenance.
requirements.partial: Real SFace accuracy is not validated; synthetic acceptance used stubbed inference.
requirements.missing: R4C and real-world same-person validation.
requirements.limitations: Scores are visual similarity, not identity confidence.
requirements.evidence: 26 candidate-search tests and embedding-store tests executed.

requirements.official_requirement: Provide role-based access for authorised investigators.
requirements.frontend_workflow: One global local passphrase modal; all navigation visible unconditionally.
requirements.test_result: Passed client session tests only; no RBAC tests exist.
requirements.what_works: Optional single global passphrase gate.
requirements.partial: Not role-based; open mode exists when no passphrase is configured.
requirements.missing: Users, roles, per-case grants, route guards, actor identity, expiry/revocation and audit attribution.
requirements.limitations: Case_id scoping is data filtering, not authorization.
requirements.evidence: PUBLIC_PATHS and local_session_guard source inspection; no Depends/roles/users in backend app.

requirements.official_requirement: Provide an audit log.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Recent activity card only.
requirements.test_result: Passed: selected actions recorded, reviewer note excluded, rollback on audit failure.
requirements.what_works: Append-only SQLite events for case/video/frame/export/review/search actions and inclusion in exports.
requirements.partial: No actor column, no dedicated audit API/page, incomplete event coverage.
requirements.missing: Tamper-evidence, WORM, actor attribution, full read/download event coverage and dedicated export.
requirements.limitations: Local SQLite rows are not tamper-proof.
requirements.evidence: audit_events schema and executed audit assertions.

requirements.official_requirement: Upload a clip with transaction time and obtain best face frames with quality scores.
requirements.frontend_workflow: Investigation and CV run pages provide the workflow, but no browser interaction E2E was executed.

requirements.missing: Person linked to ATM keypad/cash-slot transaction; validated best identifiable face.
requirements.limitations: Real CCTV/R4C validation absent.
requirements.evidence: MH-1 score 73.3 in scoring section.
